sources.title: Sources and notes
sources.estimateText: Figures from the RIVM come from a survey of a sample of residents. They therefore carry the label “Estimate” and are less precise than counts.
sources.roundedText: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) rounds neighbourhood figures to multiples of five. The age groups therefore add up to 1,375 instead of 1,381.
sources.viaTail: , which bundles data from the sources above (reference date {date}). The original source is stated with each chart.
sources.useText: CBS figures fall under CC BY 4.0; credit the original source when reusing them.

rows.name: CBS
rows.what: Residents, households, housing, income, work, facilities

rows.name: Kadaster (BAG)
rows.what: Addresses, home type, construction period, address uses

mensen.name: People
mensen.message: Young, many single-person households, increasingly international
mensen.factText: has Dutch origin; in 2013 that was still 66%.
mensen.more: Men and women · Marital status · Country of birth · Births and deaths

wonen.name: Housing
wonen.message: Almost everyone lives in an apartment from before 1945
wonen.factText: of the 960 addresses date from before 1925.
wonen.more: Types of homes · Occupied and vacant · Address uses

werk.name: Work and money
werk.message: High incomes, lots of business services

mobiliteit.name: Mobility
mobiliteit.message: Few cars per household, electric is growing fast
mobiliteit.factText: electric cars in September 2026; in March 2022 there were 16.

veiligheid.name: Safety
veiligheid.message: Very densely built; bicycle theft is the largest item
veiligheid.factText: of the 115 crimes in 2025 were thefts of bicycles, mopeds or scooters.

gezondheid.name: Health and well-being
gezondheid.message: Good perceived health and satisfied with the surroundings
gezondheid.factText: is satisfied with the living environment (estimate).

voorzieningen.name: Facilities and education
voorzieningen.message: Everything within walking distance, except a school in the neighbourhood itself
voorzieningen.factText: on average to the nearest restaurant; supermarket and GP 0.3 km.

vergelijking.name: Comparison
vergelijking.message: What makes Duivelseiland different from the rest of the Netherlands
vergelijking.factText: as densely populated as the Dutch average.
vergelijking.more: Property value and share of over-65s

herkomst.title: Origin of residents by year
herkomst.sub: The share of residents with Dutch origin fell from 66% (2013) to 45% (2025).
herkomst.note: 2022: the source has no breakdown into Europe and outside Europe. That year is marked as missing, not as zero.
herkomst.aria: Stacked area chart: origin of residents 2013 to 2025; the Dutch share falls from 66% to 45%

leeftijd.title: Residents by age
leeftijd.sub: Half of the residents are between 25 and 45 years old.
leeftijd.note: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) rounds to multiples of five; the groups therefore add up to 1,375 instead of 1,381.

inwoners.title: Residents per year
inwoners.sub: Roughly stable around 1,400; slightly declining since 2024.
inwoners.note: The vertical axis starts at 1,300 so that the small fluctuations are visible.
inwoners.aria: Line chart: residents per year 2013 to 2026, roughly stable around 1,400

huishoudens.title: Households
huishoudens.sub: 59% live alone; on average 1.6 people per household.
huishoudens.note: Rounded to multiples of five; the groups add up to 855 of 860.
huishoudens.aria: Donut chart: households by type; 59% are single-person households

geboorte.title: Births and deaths per 1,000 residents
geboorte.note: In 2025: 15 births and 5 deaths in absolute numbers.
geboorte.aria: Line chart: births and deaths per 1,000 residents, 2013 to 2025

sankey.title: Country of birth and origin
sankey.sub: 820 residents were born in the Netherlands, 570 elsewhere.
sankey.aria: From country of birth to origin: 820 born in the Netherlands, 570 abroad

woz.title: Average property value (WOZ) per year
woz.sub: From € 290,000 to € 611,000: more than doubled (+111%) since 2013.
woz.aria: Line chart: average property value 2013 to 2025, from € 290,000 to € 611,000

eigendom.title: Owned and rented
eigendom.sub: More than half is rented from a private landlord.
eigendom.aria: Donut chart: owned and rented; 35% owned, 65% rented

bouw.title: Construction period of the addresses
bouw.note: Number of addresses per construction period of the building; from 1950 the number is 0.

energie.title: Energy labels
energie.sub: Label C is the most common; 194 addresses have label G.
energie.note: Labels A+++ and higher do not occur. 38 addresses have no label, 152 have a provisional label.
energie.aria: Bar chart: energy labels of addresses; label C is the most common, 194 addresses have label G

verbruik.title: Gas and electricity per home
verbruik.sub: Gas use fell from 1,100 m³ (2013) to 640 m³ (2024).
verbruik.note: Two separate charts, each with its own unit and axis.

bewoning.title: Occupied and vacant
bewoning.aria: Donut chart: occupied and vacant homes

gebruiksdoelen.title: What addresses are used for
gebruiksdoelen.note: Only functions with at least one address; the others (for example sports and lodging) are 0.

inkomen.title: Income
inkomen.sub: One and a half times the Dutch average (€ 34,900).
inkomen.aria: Average income per resident: Duivelseiland € 58,400, Amsterdam € 41,000, Netherlands € 34,900

ikvergelijk.title: Income per resident in the neighbourhoods of the Museumkwartier
ikvergelijk.aria: Bar chart: average income per resident per neighbourhood in the Museumkwartier

bedrijven.title: Business establishments by sector
bedrijven.sub: Of the 405 establishments, a third are business services.

voertuigen.title: Vehicles registered to residents
voertuigen.note: The RDW counts all vehicles registered at addresses in the neighbourhood. The CBS count below is a different series; do not compare them.

elektrisch.title: Electric cars per month
elektrisch.note: 63 electric cars: 60 passenger cars and 3 company vehicles. The 106 in the fuel chart also includes 43 electric mopeds.
elektrisch.aria: Line chart: electric cars per month, from 16 in March 2022 to 63 in September 2026

ongevallen.title: Traffic accidents per year
ongevallen.sub: 14 accidents in 2025: 11 with property damage, 3 with injury, 0 fatal.
ongevallen.aria: Stacked bar chart: traffic accidents per year 2003 to 2025; 14 accidents in 2025

dichtheid.title: Density per km²
dichtheid.sub: Duivelseiland is 43 times as densely populated as the Netherlands.
dichtheid.note: Each row has its own scale; the grey bar is the Netherlands.

misdaadjaren.title: Registered crimes per year
misdaadjaren.aria: Line chart: registered crimes per year 2012 to 2025; around 110 since 2015

misdaadsoorten.title: Most common crimes in 2025
misdaadsoorten.sub: 39 of the 115 crimes were thefts of bicycles, mopeds or scooters.

tevreden.title: Satisfied with living
tevreden.sub: 90% are satisfied with their living environment.

gezondheid.title: Residents in good health
gezondheid.note: Based on a survey (sample), hence an estimate.
gezondheid.aria: Line chart: share of residents in good health by age group, 2012 to 2024

welzijn.title: Well-being and loneliness
welzijn.sub: 93% receive support from others; 48% feel lonely.

voorzieningen.title: Average distance to facilities
voorzieningen.sub: Almost everything within a kilometre; only the train station is further away (2.1 km).
voorzieningen.note: Average road distance from an address in the neighbourhood.
voorzieningen.aria: Average distance to facilities in kilometres; nearby on the left

school.title: Distance to schools and childcare (km)
school.sub: Secondary education is on average 0.4 km away; in the Netherlands 2.5 km.
school.note: There is no school or childcare in the neighbourhood itself.

leerlingen.title: Pupils and students living in the neighbourhood
leerlingen.sub: 180 in total; university students are the largest group (70).

opleiding.title: Education level (ages 15 to 75)
opleiding.sub: 940 of the 1,230 residents have a higher education level.
opleiding.note: The 76% is derived from the counts; the source wrongly shows 100% here. The years differ (2023 and 2024).
opleiding.aria: Donut chart: education level of residents aged 15 to 75; 76% have a higher level

onderscheid.title: What sets Duivelseiland apart from the Netherlands
onderscheid.sub: Each row has its own scale.
onderscheid.note: Higher educated: 76% is derived from the counts (940 of 1,230); the source wrongly shows 100% here.
onderscheid.aria: Duivelseiland compared with Amsterdam and the Netherlands on five characteristics

verkiezingen.title: Municipal elections, 18 March 2026
verkiezingen.sub: Number of votes, ordered by votes. One colour for all parties.
verkiezingen.note: Sum of the two polling stations in the neighbourhood. {count} smaller parties are not shown ({votes} votes). Share is calculated from {total} votes.

scatter.title: Property value and share of over-65s
scatter.note: Museumplein and Vondelpark-Oost have fewer than 10 homes and are statistically unreliable (dotted circles).
scatter.aria: Scatter chart: property value against share of over-65s per neighbourhood
